ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by dominant high-intensity white regions on the distal lobes (approx. 65%) and low-intensity black regions in the central medial section and along the posterior margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white geometric regions occupying the lateral-distal portions of both lobes. The right lobe contains a distinctive series of 5-7 parallel vertical dark streaks. The medial region is defined by a solid dark triangular mask centered at the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (estimated 8-15 pixel depth) present along the continuous trailing boundary, exhibiting significant jaggedness and irregular peak-to-valley spacing.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the anterior edge tapering to a sharp, irregular lateral-posterior vertex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-contrast dark circular pixel groups located at the extreme lateral tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions crossing the high-intensity white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive fragmentation and non-linear material loss along the trailing edge perimeter, particularly at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly organized vertical dark banding pattern on the right lobe's ventral white surface.
